description: How to use the moon phase tarot spread: eight cards for the lunar cycle, what each phase asks, and how to read it in one sitting or across a month.
lede: The moon phase tarot spread uses eight cards, one for each phase of the lunar cycle. The phases work as a metaphor for starting, building, seeing and releasing.

layout.alt: Eight gold-edged tarot cards arranged in a ring under the heading A moon phase tarot spread, numbered 1 to 8 and labelled in order: 1 New moon, 2 Waxing crescent, 3 First quarter, 4 Waxing gibbous, 5 Full moon, 6 Waning gibbous, 7 Last quarter, 8 Waning crescent.
layout.caption: Eight cards follow the lunar cycle in a ring, from seeds at the new moon to rest at the waning crescent.
